Notice
Welcome to our website. We hope you enjoy taking a look around. Please do not hesitate to get in touch if you have any queries.
Welcome
At Kingsley High School, everything we do is focused on ensuring our pupils "Enjoy and Achieve." We understand that every student is unique and has their own set of needs, and we strive to provide the very best personal care to support them. Our focus is on Teaching and Learning, with high expectations for all students to reach their full potential.
The work we do is centered on the following values:
Our school community is one of diversity and inclusivity, where we celebrate the unique strengths and talents of each individual. Our dedicated staff team embodies these values in all their work, and are committed to ensuring that our pupils are consistently achieving positive outcomes. We are always happy to welcome enquiries about the work we do, and are passionate about spreading awareness about SEND throughout the community. Join us in our mission to empower our pupils to Enjoy and Achieve in all aspects of their lives.
Our dedicated team of teachers and support staff have extensive experience and training in working with pupils who have a wide range of disabilities and learning difficulties. We believe that every child has the right to an education that meets their needs and enables them to reach their full potential.
Our curriculum is specifically designed to meet the needs of our pupils, and is flexible and adaptable to accommodate the diverse abilities of our students. We ensure we support core learning such as reading, writing, and maths, and our teachers use a variety of strategies and techniques to support the unique needs of each pupil.
In addition to our core curriculum, we also offer a range of specialised programs and activities to support the emotional, social, and physical well-being of our pupils. We work with health, social care, occupational therapists, speech therapists, and other specialists who work closely with pupils to help them develop the skills they need to succeed.
At Kingsley High School, we believe that every pupil with special educational needs has the right to an education that is tailored to their individual needs and abilities It is truly inspiring to see the progress and achievements our pupils make, and the positive impact that our school community has on their lives. We are proud of the work we do and the difference we make in the lives of our pupils. Please explore our website to see more of the work we do and thank you for visiting.

Welcome to our website. We hope you enjoy taking a look around. Please do not hesitate to get in touch if you have any queries.
Information for Parents
Whilst it is accepted that opportunities for Kingsley's learners to enter employment may be limited, this does not mean we do not aspire for our learners to develop skills and knowledge to enable them to make the most of any opportunity that may arise.
The school's pathways are geared towards preparation for adulthood via continuing further education, either locally or at specialist provision. These are typical pathways, although Some learners may however transition to community or supported living placements after school.
The school's curriculum offers opportunities for:
The school has a linked Independent Careers Advice and Guidance advisor, employed by the Prospects branch of the Shaw Trust. The advisor works closely with learners and their families as they prepare for transition out of school. This is primarily focussed on Year 14 learners.
The school works closely with the Employability and Careers arm of the Education Development Trust, and has a linked Enterprise Co-ordinator.
